reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 0, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: What day of the week comes right after Friday?
What day of the week comes right after Saturday?
What month of the year comes right before December?
What day of the week comes right after Tuesday?
What day of the week comes right before Thursday?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All five samples directly test sequencing knowledge, e.g. seed 44's 'What month of the year comes right before December?' resolving to November, matching 'give the days of the week and months of the year in the correct order' precisely.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Four of the five samples, seeds 42, 43, 45, 46, test days-of-week sequencing and only one, seed 44, tests months-of-year sequencing, so the 'months of the year' half of this competency is substantially under-represented relative to days.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Short 'comes right after/before X' stems such as seed 46's 'What day of the week comes right before Thursday?' are appropriately concise for Grade 1 Quarter 4 sequential recall.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Both directions of sequencing appear: 'after', seeds 42, 43, 45, and 'before', seeds 44, 46, giving reasonable directional variety for a sequencing task within the five samples.

competency_alignment.rationale: All variation is in which specific day or month pair is queried and which direction is asked, directly building day/month ordering recall without drifting into unrelated content.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Testing single-step adjacency, the day or month immediately before/after a given one, rather than multi-step counting is an appropriately simple scope for Grade 1 Quarter 4.
